description:
"Bare your fangs and gnash your teeth into an enemy while ripping back, dealing |cffffff4084|r Physical Damage on the initial lunge and |cffffff4084|r Bleed Damage while ripping out. 

Consumes a stack of Blood Hunger to increase the initial damage done by |cffffff25|r%. 

The second hit deals up to |cffffff125|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff25|r% Health."
